landing.hero_subtitle: Find nearby procurement centres, book your delivery slot, track your queue, and follow your payment status — all from one place.
landing.features_title: Built for Farmers, Mandis, and Government Transparency
landing.features_subtitle: Every capability is designed to eliminate crowding, reduce waiting time, and guarantee direct MSP payments.
landing.feature_1_desc: Find procurement centres near your registered or current location.
landing.feature_2_desc: Choose a convenient delivery date and time before visiting the centre.
landing.feature_3_desc: Get a digital token and follow your position in the live queue.
landing.feature_4_desc: Follow quality verification, weighing, receipt and payment stages.
landing.steps_subtitle: A predictable and transparent process designed for ease of use.
landing.step_1_desc: Create your farmer account and provide your administrative location.
landing.step_2_desc: Discover suitable procurement centres near you.
landing.step_4_desc: Arrive at the centre using your digital token.
landing.step_5_desc: Follow procurement and payment progress digitally.
landing.trust_title: Integrated Digital Coordination Across the Procurement Lifecycle
landing.trust_desc: AgriNexus brings together verified centre discovery, slot capacity protection, digital queue tokens, verified electronic weight slips, and direct payment tracking into one unified workflow.
landing.trust_item_1_desc: Location-aware distance calculations and transparent capacity indicators help you choose the best mandi.
landing.trust_item_2_desc: Strict quintal limits per time window prevent centre overload and eliminate multi-day queue delays.
landing.trust_item_3_desc: Immutable records for moisture testing, net weight calculations, and official digital receipts.
landing.trust_item_4_desc: Direct-to-bank-account payment tracking with transparent stage milestones and SLA tracking.
landing.cta_banner_title: Ready to Streamline Your Crop Procurement?
landing.cta_banner_desc: Join thousands of farmers booking confirmed arrival windows and tracking MSP payments with full transparency.
landing.footer_rights: Public Agricultural Procurement Service. All rights reserved.
landing.footer_gov: Department of Consumer Affairs • Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution • Government of India
landing.footer_tagline: Right Information. Right Time. Right Place.
